title: Fixed ringed Hom augmentation and representative comparison
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ have object universe $c$ and arrow universe $v$, let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology with sheafification of $\operatorname{AddCommGrpCat}_{\max(c,v,u)}$ and with locally bijective maps equal to the sheafification equivalences, and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in universe $\max(c,v,u)$. Use the category $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its cochain complexes and chosen derived localization $Q:\operatorname{CoCh}(\operatorname{Mod}(R))\to D(R)$ in Hom universe $w$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the product-total Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex]. Use the fixed functorial K-injective replacement $I(F)$ and localization-factorization isomorphism $\lambda_{E,F}:R\mathcal Hom(QE,QF)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,I(F))$ [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation], with the recorded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For any complex $F$, define $\eta_F:F\to I(F)$ to be the component at $F$ of the fixed natural transformation $\operatorname{toKInjectiveResolution}$. For any complexes $E,F$, define the representative comparison by the actual composite $\rho_{E,F}:=Q(\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,\eta_F))\,;\,\lambda_{E,F}^{-1}:Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,F)\to R\mathcal Hom(QE,QF)$. These definitions impose no K-flatness, K-injectivity, boundedness or finiteness assumption on $E,F$; they specify the augmentation and comparison maps themselves.
